nodes.title: Prompt
widgets_values: A surreal nightmare sequence. Figures in white biohazard suits performing a frantic, distorted dance in a dark void. The movement is jittery, reminiscent of an old VHS tape glitch. Rapid erratic camera cuts and quick dolly zooms. The lighting flickers. The atmosphere is heavy with dread and "dreamcore" nostalgia. Eerie, uncanny valley, surrealist horror.
